High-level Nim wrapper for Pebble Vibes (Vibration) API.

Provides haptic feedback through vibration patterns.

../ffi

Procs

proc cancel() {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Cancel any ongoing vibration. Equivalent to C function vibes_cancel(). 
proc doublePulse() {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Trigger a double vibration pulse. Equivalent to C function vibes_double_pulse(). 
proc enqueueCustomPattern(durations: ptr uint32; numSegments: uint32) {.inline,
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Enqueue a custom vibration pattern. durations is an array of segment durations in milliseconds. Odd indices are ON durations, even indices are OFF durations. Example: [100, 50, 100] means vibrate 100ms, pause 50ms, vibrate 100ms. Equivalent to C function vibes_enqueue_custom_pattern(). 
proc longPulse() {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Trigger a long vibration pulse. Equivalent to C function vibes_long_pulse().

Trigger a short vibration pulse. Equivalent to C function vibes_short_pulse().
